LESSON: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni
2. kujadili vidokezo kulingana na mada ya kuandikia insha ya kubuni
3. kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha ya kubuni

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni
   In simple words: practise until you can kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili vidokezo kulingana na mada ya kuandikia insha ya kubuni
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vidokezo kulingana na mada ya kuandikia insha ya kubuni. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha ya kubuni
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha ya kubuni. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni.
4. Show that you can: kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 3.3.1 Insha za Kubuni important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kuteua mada na ujumbe wa kuandikia insha ya kubuni
2. kujadili vidokezo kulingana na mada ya kuandikia insha ya kubuni
3. kuandika vidokezo vyenye ujumbe unaolingana na mada ya insha ya kubuni

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
